grammar.summary: 本课学习表"程度"的 in proportion 与信任类动词搭配。

points.title: 表"信任"的 place faith in
points.explanation: place one's faith in the doctor = 把信任交给医生。faith/trust + in 的固定介词。

examples.en: Patients place their faith in their doctors.
examples.cn: 病人把信心寄托在医生身上。

points.title: it is arguable that 表可商榷
points.explanation: It is arguable that... = 值得商榷的是……。学术性评价句式，与 it is true that 平行。

examples.en: It is arguable that most medicine is unnecessary.
examples.cn: 多数药物是否必要是值得商榷的。
